title: Argos Reviews Scraper
description: Collect customer reviews from Argos product pages.

productUrl.title: Product URL
productUrl.description: Optional Argos product URL. Clean and messy URLs are both accepted as long as they contain the product ID.

productId.title: Product ID
productId.description: Optional Argos product ID. Use this if you already know the product part number.

resultsWanted.title: Results wanted per product
resultsWanted.description: Maximum number of reviews to collect for each product URL.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages per product
maxPages.description: Safety cap for review pages per product.

sortBy.title: Sort reviews by
sortBy.description: Choose how reviews should be sorted.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. Enable Apify Proxy if your account setup requires it.
